listing.name: Tomb Raider I-III / TRX (LostArtefacts)
listing.summary: Set up Tomb Raider I–III with TRX and the original files for the games you own.

steps.title: Windows setup
steps.instruction: Run the upstream Windows Installer EXE yourself. Choose a separate TRX folder and the packs you want. Point the installer to supported Steam, GOG or disc installations for the corresponding games. After setup, register the installed TRX.exe and its containing folder.

steps.title: Linux x86-64 setup
steps.instruction: Extract the complete Linux ZIP into a writable folder. Use the upstream manual setup guide to place your original files under the matching games/<game-id>/ folders. Start TRX with its containing folder as the working directory. After setup, use that same native executable and folder for Portcove registration.

steps.title: Intel and Apple Silicon Mac setup
steps.instruction: Mount the universal Mac DMG, copy TRX.app to Applications, and open the installed app once as described by upstream. Use the upstream manual setup guide to place the original game files under the corresponding Contents/Resources/games/<game-id>/ folders. Open TRX.app from Applications to play.

warnings: The three games keep their corresponding original-data requirements. Installing the engine does not supply ownership of commercial game data.
Keep game files, cfg, saves, screenshots and any custom profile folders backed up when applying upstream updates.

references.title: Preserve the TRX game data and profiles
references.instruction: Keep a backup of your original game files, cfg, saves, screenshots and any custom profile directories before replacing the runtime. On Mac, preserve any original game files or player data stored inside the bundle before replacing TRX.app. The upstream guide explains migration from the older combined layout.
